# World boundaries

`countries.json` is derived from Natural Earth v5.1.2,
`ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson`:
https://github.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/blob/v5.1.2/geojson/ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson

Natural Earth data is public domain:
https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/

Country outlines and English/Chinese names are retained from the source.
Coordinates are projected to a simple plate carrée illustration; Antarctica is
outside this cultural-destination view. Tiny countries may not be represented at
this 1:110m scale. Source boundaries are illustrative, not a legal boundary map.
Only China has available cultural content; other entries provide availability
feedback and never create cultural records.
